new_entities.name: LetterOfCredit
new_entities.description: Aggregate root for a documentary letter of credit. Captures the full lifecycle from application through issuance to settlement or expiry. Owned exclusively by SVC-006 (Trade Finance Service). References BusinessCustomer (ENT-B001) and BusinessAccount (ENT-B002) from SVC-005 by foreign key — no local copies.

fields.name: lc_id
fields.description: Immutable LC identifier — primary key

fields.name: lc_reference
fields.description: Bank-assigned LC reference number (SWIFT field 20, max 16 chars alphanumeric)

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.description: Applicant — references BusinessCustomer in SVC-005. Read via same-capability API. No local copy.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: Applicant's BusinessAccount to be debited on settlement. References SVC-005 entity by FK.

fields.name: lc_type
fields.description: Letter of credit type. sight = immediate payment on compliant presentation. usance = deferred payment at tenor.

fields.name: status
fields.type: enum (application_submitted | under_review | compliance_blocked | credit_declined | issued | documents_presented | documents_under_examination | settled | expired | documents_refused | cancelled)
fields.description: Current lifecycle status of the LC.

fields.name: credit_status
fields.description: Result of PH-053 credit/facility headroom check.

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.description: Result of PH-054 compliance screening.

fields.name: compliance_cleared_at
fields.description: Timestamp when EVT-077 (LCComplianceCleared) was received from SVC-051.

fields.name: beneficiary_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the beneficiary (seller / exporter). Used in SWIFT MT700 field 59.

fields.name: beneficiary_address
fields.description: Beneficiary full postal address.

fields.name: beneficiary_country_iso2
fields.description: Beneficiary country — used in sanctions and export control screening.

fields.name: advising_bank_swift_bic
fields.description: SWIFT BIC of the advising bank (beneficiary's bank). SWIFT MT700 field 57.

fields.name: advising_bank_name
fields.description: Name of advising bank.

fields.name: currency_iso3
fields.description: LC currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

fields.name: lc_amount
fields.description: Face value of the LC in the nominated currency.

fields.name: tolerance_pct
fields.description: UCP 600 Article 18(b) tolerance — default 5% over/under. Stored as percentage (e.g. 5.00).

fields.name: goods_description
fields.description: Description of goods as they will appear in the LC (SWIFT MT700 field 45A). Must not be vague — UCP 600 and ISBP 745 require sufficiently specific description.

fields.name: hs_tariff_codes
fields.description: Harmonised System tariff codes for goods. Used for export control / dual-use screening by SVC-051.

fields.name: incoterms_rule
fields.type: enum (EXW | FCA | CPT | CIP | DAP | DPU | DDP | FAS | FOB | CFR | CIF)
fields.description: Incoterms 2020 rule governing delivery obligations and risk transfer.

fields.name: port_of_loading
fields.description: Named place / port of loading for shipment.

fields.name: port_of_discharge
fields.description: Named place / port of discharge.

fields.name: latest_shipment_date
fields.description: Latest date on which goods may be shipped (bill of lading date constraint). SWIFT MT700 field 44C.

fields.name: expiry_date
fields.description: Date on which the LC expires. Documents must be presented on or before this date. SWIFT MT700 field 31D.

fields.name: expiry_place
fields.description: Place where the LC expires — typically at the counters of the issuing bank.

fields.name: presentation_period_days
fields.description: Maximum days after shipment date for document presentation. Default 21 days per UCP 600 Article 14(c). May be shorter by LC terms.

fields.name: required_documents
fields.type: array of object { document_type: string, copies_required: integer, originals_required: integer, special_conditions: string }
fields.description: Document checklist as specified in the LC. Forms the basis for PH-057 examination.

fields.name: partial_shipments_permitted
fields.description: Whether partial shipments are permitted. Default false.

fields.name: transshipment_permitted
fields.description: Whether transshipment is permitted. Default false for sensitive goods/routes.

fields.name: usance_period_days
fields.description: For usance LCs: deferred payment tenor in days from bill of lading date or sight. Null for sight LCs.

fields.name: usance_maturity_date
fields.description: Calculated maturity date for deferred payment. Populated after compliant document examination.

fields.name: swift_reference
fields.description: SWIFT MT700 field 20 — documentary credit number as transmitted to advising bank.

fields.name: issue_date
fields.description: Date LC was issued and SWIFT MT700 transmitted.

fields.name: settlement_date
fields.description: Date on which settlement payment was made.

fields.name: settlement_amount
fields.description: Actual settlement amount — may differ from lc_amount due to partial drawings or tolerance.

fields.name: facility_check_timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp of PH-053 facility headroom verification against SVC-005.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Channel through which the LC application was submitted.

fields.name: etda_compliant_platform
fields.description: True if LC issued via ETDA 2023-compliant electronic trade document platform (Bolero / essDOCS).

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Record creation timestamp (PH-052 application submission).

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Last modification timestamp — updated on every status transition.

relationships.description: An LC may have zero or more amendments. Each amendment references lc_id.
An LC has one or more document presentations. Each TradeDocument set references lc_id.
An LC has one DocumentExamination per presentation event.
FK reference to applicant. No local copy. Read via SVC-005 GET /business-customers/{id}.
FK reference to settlement account. No local copy. Read via SVC-005 GET /business-accounts/{id}.

design_decisions: status field is the master lifecycle state machine. All phase transitions map to a status transition.
hs_tariff_codes is an array to support multi-commodity shipments. Each code is a 6-digit HS code; sub-heading extensions (8/10 digit) stored in goods_description for document examination.
required_documents array stores the exact document checklist specified in the LC terms. Used as the reference set for PH-057 examination checklist generation in ENT-039.

usance_maturity_date is computed by SVC-006 on receipt of compliant documents, based on usance_period_days from the bill of lading date — it is not stored at issuance to avoid stale data if BL date differs from expected shipment date.

new_entities.name: LCAmendment
new_entities.description: Represents a formal amendment to an issued Letter of Credit. Each amendment is subject to beneficiary acceptance (UCP 600 Article 10 — amendment is not operative until accepted by beneficiary). Amendments that change beneficiary details or goods trigger a new compliance screening cycle via EVT-076. Owned by SVC-006.

fields.name: amendment_id
fields.description: Immutable amendment identifier.

fields.name: lc_id
fields.description: Reference to parent LetterOfCredit.

fields.name: amendment_number
fields.description: Sequential amendment number (1, 2, 3...). Used in SWIFT MT707 field 26E.

fields.name: amendment_type
fields.type: array of enum (amount_increase | amount_decrease | expiry_extension | expiry_reduction | latest_shipment_extension | document_change | beneficiary_change | terms_change)
fields.description: Classification of amendment type(s). Multiple types may apply to one amendment.

fields.name: status
fields.type: enum (draft | compliance_screening | issued | accepted | rejected | pending_acceptance)
fields.description: Amendment lifecycle status.

fields.name: amended_fields
fields.type: object (key-value map of LC fields being amended, with old_value and new_value)
fields.description: Audit-grade record of exactly which LC fields are being changed.

fields.name: compliance_rescreening_required
fields.description: True if amendment changes beneficiary name/country, goods description, or HS codes — triggers new EVT-076.

fields.name: swift_mt707_reference
fields.description: SWIFT MT707 message reference as transmitted to advising bank.

fields.name: applicant_instruction_date
fields.description: Date applicant instructed the amendment.

fields.name: issued_date
fields.description: Date amendment was transmitted to advising bank.

fields.name: beneficiary_acceptance_date
fields.description: Date beneficiary formally accepted the amendment. Null = pending or rejected.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Record creation timestamp.

design_decisions: Under UCP 600 Article 10(b), an amendment is irrevocable once issued but does NOT take effect until the beneficiary accepts it. The pending_acceptance status models this intermediate state.
amended_fields stores the full before/after delta as a JSON object — this provides audit evidence and enables rollback logic if an amendment is rejected by the beneficiary.

new_entities.name: TradeDocument
new_entities.description: Represents the complete set of documents presented under an LC. A single TradeDocument record aggregates all documents in one presentation event. Multiple presentation events against the same LC (e.g. partial shipments) create separate TradeDocument records. Owned by SVC-006.

fields.name: presentation_id
fields.description: Unique presentation identifier.

fields.name: lc_id
fields.description: Reference to parent LetterOfCredit.

fields.name: presentation_date
fields.description: Date on which documents were received by the issuing bank (or advising/presenting bank for deferred forwarding). This is the date from which the 5-banking-day UCP 600 examination period runs.

fields.name: presentation_deadline
fields.description: Last date documents could have been presented: lesser of (latest_shipment_date + presentation_period_days) and lc expiry_date.

fields.name: presented_on_time
fields.description: True if presentation_date <= presentation_deadline.

fields.name: bill_of_lading_date
fields.description: On-board notation date from the bill of lading — establishes the shipment date for presentation period calculation.

fields.name: drawing_amount
fields.description: Amount being drawn under this presentation. May be less than lc_amount for partial drawings.

fields.name: currency_iso3
fields.description: Currency of the drawing amount.

fields.name: documents
fields.type: array of object { document_type: string, copies_received: integer, originals_received: integer, document_reference: string, document_date: date, issuer: string, storage_reference: string (SVC-054 document store ref) }
fields.description: Individual documents in the presentation set. Storage_reference points to the actual document in SVC-054 (Document Management).

fields.name: presentation_channel
fields.description: How documents were presented to the issuing bank.

fields.name: status
fields.type: enum (received | under_examination | compliant | discrepant | waiver_obtained | refused | paid)
fields.description: Presentation status.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Record creation timestamp.

relationships.description: Each presentation has exactly one examination record.

design_decisions: document storage references point to SVC-054 (Document Management) — the actual document images/PDFs are stored in SVC-054, not in SVC-006's PostgreSQL database. ENT-038 holds the metadata and checklist, SVC-054 holds the binary content.
presentation_deadline is computed and stored at presentation receipt time, not at LC issuance, because it depends on the actual bill of lading date which is only known at presentation.

new_entities.name: DocumentExamination
new_entities.description: Represents the formal document examination result for one presentation event. Records the examination decision, each document's individual compliance status, and any discrepancy codes (referencing UCP 600 and ISBP 745 articles). Immutable once finalised — examination results are auditable regulatory evidence. Owned by SVC-006.

fields.name: examination_id
fields.description: Unique examination identifier.

fields.name: presentation_id
fields.description: Reference to the document presentation being examined.

fields.name: lc_id
fields.description: Reference to the LetterOfCredit for direct join convenience.

fields.name: examiner_id
fields.description: SVC-006 staff member who performed the examination (PER-059). Must hold CDCS or equivalent qualification per bank policy.

fields.name: examination_started_at
fields.description: When examination commenced.

fields.name: examination_deadline
fields.description: UCP 600 Article 14(b) deadline: presentation_date + 5 banking days. Hard system constraint — not extendable.

fields.name: examination_completed_at
fields.description: When examination decision was finalised.

fields.name: examination_result
fields.description: Overall examination outcome. deadline_missed triggers compliance incident (SVC-006 loses right to refuse under UCP 600 Article 16(f)).

fields.name: document_findings
fields.type: array of object { document_type: string, compliant: boolean, discrepancies: array of { discrepancy_code: string, ucp_article: string, isbp_paragraph: string, description: string } }
fields.description: Per-document examination results. Each discrepancy cites the specific UCP 600 article and ISBP 745 paragraph for legal precision.

fields.name: applicant_waiver_obtained
fields.description: True if applicant has formally waived discrepancies. Populated only where examination_result = discrepant.

fields.name: waiver_received_at
fields.description: Timestamp of applicant waiver instruction — must be before examination_deadline.

fields.name: waiver_instruction_reference
fields.description: Reference to applicant waiver instruction document (stored in SVC-054).

fields.name: swift_mt750_reference
fields.description: SWIFT MT750 (Advice of Discrepancy) reference if discrepancy notice transmitted to presenting bank.

fields.name: swift_mt734_reference
fields.description: SWIFT MT734 (Advice of Refusal) reference if refusal notice transmitted to presenting bank.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Record creation timestamp.

relationships.description: Examination belongs to one document presentation.
Examination references the parent LC directly.

design_decisions: DocumentExamination is immutable once examination_result is set. Any post-examination waiver creates a separate waiver record referenced by waiver_instruction_reference — the examination finding itself is never modified.

deadline_missed is a distinct terminal state from discrepant — it records the specific compliance failure (UCP 600 Article 16(f) preclusion) and triggers a separate compliance incident workflow, not the normal discrepancy management workflow.

Each discrepancy entry in document_findings cites both the UCP 600 article and the ISBP 745 paragraph. This is required for the SWIFT MT750/MT734 notice and for any subsequent dispute resolution under the ICC Banking Commission.

referenced_existing_entities.name: BusinessCustomer
referenced_existing_entities.usage: JRN-013 applicant reference — read via SVC-005 GET /business-customers/{id}. SVC-006 stores business_customer_id FK in ENT-036 only.

referenced_existing_entities.name: BusinessAccount
referenced_existing_entities.usage: Settlement account for LC payment — debited by SVC-006 calling SVC-005 (same-capability) in PH-058.
